items.name: DPIIT Startup recognition (Startup India)
items.gives: Recognition unlocks: self-certification (labour/environment), 80% rebate on patent filing + free facilitator fees, 80-IAC income-tax holiday (3 of first 10 yrs; Pvt Ltd/LLP incorporated after 1 Apr 2016), GeM/EMD exemptions, and is the gateway to SISFS and many incubator calls.
items.eligibility: Pvt Ltd / registered partnership / LLP; <=10 yrs from incorporation; turnover <= Rs 200 cr; not formed by splitting an existing business; innovative/scalable.
items.intima_needs: Confirm Intima's legal entity (if still a proprietorship, incorporate as Pvt Ltd/LLP first); certificate of incorporation, short product description, website (intimacare.in).
items.notes: Prerequisite for most Indian govt/incubator money. Source page opened and read on verified_on date. (The dedicated recognition URL returned 404 on the check date - apply via startupindia.gov.in.)

drafts.title: STPI MedTech OCP 7.0 (deadline 8 Oct 2026) - application text DRAFT (not submitted)

blocks.label: Problem
blocks.text: Sensitive reproductive and sexual health is under-served in India: people delay care due to stigma and distrust of how health apps handle data. Clinicians also lack structured patient-reported data between visits (cycles, symptoms, energy, labs), which weakens follow-up and prognosis conversations.

blocks.label: Solution / problem-statement fit
blocks.text: Intima Health is an anonymous, no-login patient-reported-outcomes and guidance platform (cycle/ovulation/BBT/IVF/pregnancy for women; energy, stress, ED score, low-T screen and labs for men; AI wellness companion with safety guardrails; Partner Mode; doctor map + anonymous booking + chat/video). Best OCP 7.0 alignment: Problem Statement #6 (AI-based digitisation of patient data, follow-up, and prognostic assessment in Indian settings) and #12 (other Health Informatics / HealthTech services). We are a health-informatics / PRO software product, not a MedElectronics hardware device.

blocks.label: Stage and traction (honest)
blocks.text: Live product at intimacare.in; pre-revenue. [Founder to add: users, doctor referrals, retention.] Continuous synthetic persona testing (Meera 28 PCOS/TTC; Arjun 34 stress/low energy) tracks bugs, load time and AI-companion safety. Not claiming CDSCO clearance or clinical validation yet.

blocks.label: Privacy and safety (honest)
blocks.text: No login/phone/email required. Not on-device-only: logs sync to cloud; AI chat goes to a third-party AI provider; consult messages encrypted at rest with operator-held key (not end-to-end). Companion is wellness guidance, not diagnosis; it should defer to clinicians. We will not overclaim privacy relative to competitors.

blocks.label: Eligibility checklist (founder to confirm before Sayuj submit)
blocks.text: Indian startup (Pvt Ltd / partnership / LLP) OR unregistered founders willing to incorporate within ~3 months of selection; <=10 years; turnover <= Rs 100 cr; >=51% Indian ownership; not a foreign subsidiary. DPIIT recognition encouraged. Application only via Sayuj portal (Contest → MedTech CoE OCP 7.0). No application fee.

blocks.label: Why STPI MedTech CoE / Ask
blocks.text: Need clinical mentors to validate screens/safety design; IPR/regulatory guidance on wellness vs SaMD boundary; clinical partners for a doctor-referred cohort; labs/infra as useful for future device integrations. Understand incubation equity 1–3% OR per-seat monthly fee; support based at SGPGIMS Lucknow with virtual option. Ask: selection into OCP 7.0 and opportunity to pitch Investment Committee for seed up to Rs 50 lakh to fund clinician-validated referral pilot + retention work. drafts.title: Reusable core pitch (for SISFS-type, incubator, NERVE, accelerator forms) - DRAFT

blocks.label: Problem
blocks.text: Millions of Indians avoid care for periods, PCOS/PCOD, fertility, sexual health and low energy because of stigma, judgement and fear that sensitive health data will be exposed or sold. Existing apps either require accounts and phone numbers, or push products rather than guiding people to credible care.

blocks.label: Solution
blocks.text: Intima Health (intimacare.in) is a no-login health platform for women and men. Users get an anonymous ID with a PIN and an 8-character backup code - no phone number, email or name. Women: cycle, ovulation and fertility tracking, BBT, IVF and pregnancy modes, hormonal dashboard. Men: energy/stress/vitality tracking, ED score, low-T screen, testosterone rhythm, performance log, lab results, Kegel. An AI wellness companion (30 messages/day), 7-day programs, Partner Mode, and care access: doctor map, anonymous booking, chat/video consults.

blocks.label: Traction (honest)
blocks.text: Pre-revenue. [Founder to add verified numbers: live users, doctor partners, pilot/referral counts, day-7/day-30 retention. Do not include figures that cannot be evidenced.] We run a daily synthetic-persona quality tracker (Intima Pulse) that logs issues, performance and AI-companion quality.

blocks.label: Privacy stance (honest)
blocks.text: Intima does not require identity to use the product: no login, no phone/email. It is NOT an on-device-only product: health logs sync to our cloud, AI chat messages are processed by a third-party AI provider, and consult messages are encrypted at rest with an operator-held key (not end-to-end encrypted). We make no claim beyond that.

blocks.label: Ask
blocks.text: [Founder to fill: amount, instrument, and use of funds - e.g. 6-12 months of runway to (1) lift day-30 retention of doctor-referred users, (2) validate the AI companion safety/language quality (Hindi/Hinglish), (3) run a clinician-referral pilot.]
